cards.name: Convolution Kernel Light Emboss
cards.equivalent: Color Emboss (Relief ~3, Blend With Original ~50) in Premiere; approximation only
cards.summary: Diagonal (top-left to bottom-right) relief filter: output = pixel + (bottom-right minus top-left neighbour) + 128, so edges get embossed ridges and the +128 offset pushes the whole picture up by half the range: everything above mid-grey clips to white, leaving a bright, washed-out relief.
use_for: engraved / relief texture on a background plate behind a title
stylized treatment of a logo or still in a retro explainer
abstract texture layer blended at low opacity
avoid: washes faces out completely; not for people or news footage

cards.name: 2 Strip

use_for: 1920s-40s period flashback or reconstruction in a documentary
stylized 'old newsreel in colour' archive treatment
retro aesthetic beat in a reel or trailer
avoid: shifts flag and party colours (greens to cyan, blues to teal): not for brand-, flag- or symbol-critical shots
garish on faces at full strength; lower Intensity#2 to 50-70
cards.preset_values: Lumetri Blob (custom layer) embedding the whole look: the fxTechnicolor(2strip) shader (Lumetri\Film\fxTechnicolor(2strip).irtp, from a '2strip.look'), Look stored as legacy slot 1, Intensity 100
